description: This PHP class 'LeaveTypeModel' models a leave type entity within the OrangeHRM HRM system API. It implements serialization and normalization functionalities via traits, and maps entity properties to API schema properties.

classes.name: LeaveTypeModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing and exposing leave type entities in the API which includes schema annotations for documentation.
